aiSection.title: Isesengura rihangitse ku ngaruka nziza
aiSection.description: Koresha ubwenge bw'ikora kugira ngo umenye ibintu, hanure ibyangwa, kandi utangire gufasha mbere y'uko abanyeshuri basiga inyuma.
aiSection.cardDesc: Isesengura rya nyuma ryerekana ibikorwa by'ishuri n'impamvu zishobora guteza akaga

green.title: Akagari k'icyatsi (75-100%)
green.desc: Iterambere rihebuje - Bageze aho bagombwa kuba

red.title: Akagari k'umutuku (0-49%)
red.desc: Akaga gakomeye - Hakenewe kubafasha ako kanya

testimonialsSection.title: Twizerwa n'abanyagihugu bacu
testimonialsSection.subtitle: Ibyo ababyeyi, abarezi, n'abakozi bavuga kuri Ishuri

testimonials.parent: Ubu nshoboye gukurikira iterambere ry'umwana wanjye mu gihe nyakuri. Ubutumwa bwihuse bumbwira ibyose bibaho ku ishuri.
testimonials.teacher: Umufasha wo gushyira amanota ya AI ampa amasaha menshi yo gukora. Ndashobora kwibanda ku nyigisho aho gukora iby'imyandikire.
testimonials.director: Iyi platforme yahinduye uko ducunga ishuri ryacu. Ibintu byose kuva ku myishyu kugeza ku raporo ubu bya digitale.

cta.title: Uriteguye guhindura ishuri ryawe?
cta.subtitle: Fatanya n'amashuri amajana akoresha Ishuri kugira ngo oroshye imikorere yabo.
